## Summary
A clear description of the bug and expected behavior.

## Environment
- OS & version (e.g., Windows 11 24H2 / Ubuntu 24.04 / macOS)
- Python version (`python --version`)
- Backend (`windows`, `mock`, `macos`, `linux`)
- Execution mode (`safe`, `strict`, `dry-run`)

## Reproduction Steps
1. Command or MCP call executed
2. Observed output / error
3. Expected behavior
